newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs in danger of slump below 126.22 line.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs in danger of slump below 126.22 line.

text.p: Any remaining BTP optimists will get a demoralising signal from the charts if the market takes out the 126.22 level, technical analysts said on Friday.
Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London, said 126.22 was trendline support.
"If we close below 126.22 that's going to be pretty damaging," she said.

At 0725 GMT, June BTPs on LIFFE were at 126.51, down 41 basis points from Friday. They touched a 126.30 low early in the session, breaking a 126.38 level which Miller had identified as support based on the midpoint of the recent range.
Whether BTPs took out 126.22 or not during Friday's session, Miller said they would be lured lower eventually to 125.74.
That was a 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement of the rally to 129.05 from a 123.70 low.
"With momentum maintaining a bearish formation, we stay on the bear tack," said Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London.
He said the market could head to 126.00 in due course and he advised using strength as a selling opportunity.
Eurolire were also soft on Friday. The June contract was down 0.05 at 93.06.
